material_difference: Cross-sectional relative ranking across contemporaneously eligible instruments; prior EQB block used own-instrument absolute univariate states.

instrument_filter.pit_rule: eligibility computed only from each instrument's causally-prior observations

cross_sectional_rule: At completed day t, rank only eligible instruments using feature_t; top and bottom terciles are determined from that day's eligible cross-section with deterministic trading_code tie-break. Decision after t close; execute t+1 open to t+1 close.

families.rule: long top tercile body_t; short bottom tercile
short top tercile body_t; long bottom tercile
long top tercile intraday_range_t; short bottom tercile
short top tercile intraday_range_t; long bottom tercile
long top tercile volume_shock_t; short bottom tercile
short top tercile volume_shock_t; long bottom tercile

portfolio: equal notional long leg + equal notional short leg, gross exposure 1.0, market-neutral by construction when both legs exist
